name: Classic Ruby Stone Necklace Set
description: Premium Ruby AD Necklace Set. Elegant silver finish with sparkling American Diamonds and ruby-colored stones
care:
Store in a dry, airtight pouch or box after use.
Keep away from water, perfume, lotion, sweat, and other chemicals.
Remove before bathing, swimming, exercising, or sleeping.
Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after each use.
Avoid dropping or bending the jewellery.
Keep away from direct sunlight and moisture for long-lasting shine.
